status: prospective; no transductive-frequency competition fit performed
hypothesis: For this Kaggle batch, all unlabeled test features are already available. Category counts from the complete known feature universe may reduce count noise and train/inference mismatch on rare values. Change only the count reference of R13; supervised maps and numeric scalers remain training-local.
causal_reference: round13-pooled-offset, own OOF0.9509327242594462; report own pooled and fold deltas

frequency_reference.categories: Exactly the current BPE categorical model inputs, normalized identically to clean_features; no ID or target columns.
frequency_reference.label_usage: None for reference counts. A target permutation must leave every count unchanged. All label-dependent TE/pooling remains internally cross-fitted from outer-training labels only.
frequency_reference.persistence: Persist count maps inside each trusted local model; record corpus file hashes, reference row count and canonical count-map hash. Build one column at a time, without a million-row feature-matrix copy.

validation: Exploratory transductive StratifiedKFold5/42: validation and test FEATURES participate in the declared label-free count reference. Their labels do not. This estimates the known Kaggle batch condition, not inductive prediction on a new unseen population. Same OOF IDs/labels/folds as R10; no original augmentation, global target-based pair selection, independent holdout or outer-validation early stopping. This is a separate explicit ablation of the counts excluded in R13/R14.

fixed_comparisons.selection: Report every fixed share, choose highest pooled OOF among eligible shares. Do not tune the reference population, count normalization, smoothing, model parameters or weights after seeing outcomes.

promotion_rule: Exceed frozen R10 hybrid OOF by strictly more than0.0001 and improve at least4/5 folds. Before submitting also exceed any already-selected qualifying new-round candidate. At most one submission after independent source/data/config/count-map/fold/ID/label/formula/checkpoint audits. Otherwise record the result and do not submit; no exception.
compatibility: Default glm_frequency remains outer-training-only and numerically unchanged. The new flag is opt-in, restricted to GLM/offset exploratory CV5/42 with frequency enabled; original augmentation, independent holdout and final-refit modes are excluded from this new protocol.
training_gate: Publish this plan and reviewed passing implementation before any competition AUC. Clean isolated pinned source, one CPU configuration/five fits and no paid compute. Raw competition data and count-map artifacts remain outside Git.
